title: CENTUBE MICRO Clot Activator Paediatric Blood Collection Tubes
desc: The Paediatric Clot activator blood collection tubes are specialised tubes used in blood collection. These tubes contain substances that accelerate the clotting process, allowing for serum separation after the blood sample has clotted. Brand: CENTUBE -MICRO Additive type: Clot Activator Tube size: 14X45 mm Draw volume: 0.5 ml | 1 ml Cap color: Red
